notes.title: First Gameplay Reveal teaser for After the Fall!
notes.content:
[h1]4-PLAYER VR CO-OP IN ACTION[/h1]

Time to shine. Vertigo Games is excited to reveal the first glimpse at After the Fall gameplay! Ever since releasing the cinematic trailer, we've been undying to bring true VR co-op action. We're also excited to announce that in addition to PlayStation VR and PC VR, After the Fall will also be available on the Oculus Quest platform this Summer.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d67dC6mLyqI

[h1]INTENSE VR CO-OP ACTION[/h1]

After the Fall offers cross-platform co-op, which means you can team up with your friends, no matter what VR platform they're on!


[h1]NOT YOUR AVERAGE UNDEAD[/h1]

You will need your friends to team up with against the Snowbreed, who come in different, terrifying shapes and sizes!

Wishlist it now! >> https://store.steampowered.com/app/751630/After_the_Fall/

notes.title: Traffic Jams brings traffic chaos to Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and Major PC VR Platforms in September!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/a4b36c921eaa97ea91b0f2fe86cea83fbf533e31.jpg[/img]

[h1]Get your first hands-on with the first level of Traffic Jams in the demo on Steam![/h1]

In the world of Traffic Jams all traffic lights have gone out and you are the only one who can keep traffic flowing in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. You start off in the quiet town of Gouda, but as you progress, traffic control job offers soon start pouring in from iconic cities around the globe. 

Rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite will be yours to control before road rage strikes. Yes, you read that right; meteorites! But those aren’t the only hazards; This chaotic VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301930/Traffic_Jams/

During the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Z9Zp9wzha0][b]UploadVR Summer Showcase[/b][/url], we've announced couch party mode! Share the fun of VR with up to four friends (read: frenemies), locally, on mobile devices! Have a look at the multiplayer trailer featuring none other than VR content creators [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCN0FGqUt7e79xKoPAZQ8tww][b]Cas & Chary[/b][/url]!


[h1]Meet Dennis, your instructor.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/935f8e316a856f68af08343962adf863670f55b1.jpg[/img]

Dennis is your greatest frenemy, your rival, but most importantly, for better or for worse, your teacher. Hailing from Jam City, the self-proclaimed "best traffic controller...EVER", takes you under his wing. His experience comes from the many flash mobs and packed intersections that his hometown is known for. Armed with dreams of superstardom, a sassy attitude and fresh dance moves, he has taken it upon himself to teach YOU the ropes of traffic controlling.

If you give him a chance, (and the occasional dance), he'll take you on a jam-packed global adventure to become the Ultimate Traffic Showman.

This is only the first glimpse of the cities you’ll be handling in Traffic Jams, as there will be many different challenges, each with their own crazy events to face on this worldwide trip! We hope to see you on the crossroads for the full release; Traffic Jams will be available for Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and all major PC VR platforms in September 2020.

For more news about Traffic Jams, find us on [url=http://facebook.com/vertigogames]Facebook[/url], [url=http://twitter.com/vertigogames]Twitter[/url] and [url=http://instagram.com/vertigogames]Instagram[/url] to stay up to date on all things Traffic Jams, and sign up for the newsletter at trafficjams-vr.com

notes.title: Revealed: Post-apocalyptic VR Action FPS "After the Fall"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/b2e888000ffc2edb61bfc1ccc16311ad2270ef7e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless cooperative multiplayer made for VR[/h1]

We’re excited to finally reveal our biggest VR game yet: After the Fall, an epic, post-apocalyptic multiplayer VR action FPS. Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless co-op gameplay at its core.

Set in the post-apocalyptic, ice-covered ruins of an alternate 1980s Los Angeles, in After the Fall you play in a team of up to four players, against a vast, hostile world in a raging fight for control of the city and the survival of humanity. Go solo or join forces with players worldwide as you scavenge the remains of civilization, face relentless hordes and larger-than-life bosses, craft a huge range of guns and deadly close combat weapons, and wield devastating powers with real-life movements.

[url=https://youtu.be/_0kknW-iADw]Watch the E3 trailer here.[/url]

After the Fall combines an unprecedented VR world shared with players worldwide, a cinematic and atmospheric campaign, action-packed solo and multiplayer gameplay, and endgame built from the ground up for VR. You can register for beta access for a chance to play at [url=http://afterthefall-vr.com]http://afterthefall-vr.com[/url].

[b]A word from our Studio Director, Richard Stitselaar[/b]
“Arizona Sunshine was one of the first full-feature games developed exclusively for VR. Ever since, we’ve been eager to take it up a few notches and push hard at the boundaries of VR again. With After the Fall, we’re bringing VR to life at a scale we believe hasn’t been done before – a seamless multiplayer experience set in a dynamic, changing world that will keep players coming back for more.”

After the Fall is coming to VR in 2020.  

For more news about After the Fall and to register for a chance at beta access, please visit [url=http://afterthefall-vr.com]http://afterthefall-vr.com[/url], find us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/AfterTheFallVR]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/AfterTheFallVR]Twitter[/url], and wishlist the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751630/After_the_Fall/]Steam[/url]

notes.title: A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...
notes.content:
[i][b]A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...[/b]

A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...[/i]

Innerspace VR and Vertigo Games are proud to announce that A Fisherman’s Tale, the mind-bending & multi-dimensional VR adventure is available from today for HTC Vive headsets for $14.99/EUR 14.99! 

A Fisherman’s Tale traps you inside a replica where you will need to work with infinite, ever smaller and bigger replications of yourself to find your way out of a world where physics are utterly broken.
 
Seeing is believing, so we’ve created a live-action launch trailer for you guys to check out! ==>

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uj0cxBlKK8c
[list]
[*] In a nutshell, A Fisherman’s Tale will have you:
[*] Break more than a couple laws of physics in mind-bending VR puzzles!
[*] Team up with yourself in revolutionary multi-dimensional single player co-op!
[*] Meet some of the quirkiest sidekicks to have ever set foot in a VR game
[*] Use your hands to pick up, throw, combine, and use all kinds of things in glorious fully immersive virtual reality!
[*] Toy around with your tiny little model lighthouse, inside a lighthouse, inside a... is that another lighthouse?
[*] Uncover the truth at the core of an unusually tall tale, exclusively in VR
[/list]

On top of that, A Fisherman’s Tale is a journey of both introspection and extrospection, asking players to both reach inside and outside of themselves for answers. What does it mean to reach the top of the lighthouse, and turn on the light?
 
Without VR, there wouldn’t have been an A Fisherman’s Tale. Our goal was to bring the adventure game genre to VR in a way that is meaningful to the genre. We hope you’ll think we succeeded!
 
We’re extremely excited for you to discover the game, and can’t wait to read your comments online!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33374325/21c1271686c84604fae5abd8fbef6f56b3730d71.png[/img]

[*]Battle your way through royally decorated Dragons Peak and Royal Mine skirmish maps
[*]Compete in a happy event: Announcing the [b]Skyworld Holiday 2017 Tournament[/b]!
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/bfe75523081a992ab7171856c3c7cd6a47d6e994.png[/img]
[h1]Skyworld Holiday 2017 Tournament Sponsored by AMD[/h1]

Sponsored by AMD, the [b]Skyworld Holiday 2017 Tournament[/b] lets you take on the devs and players in a knock-out tournament, win glory and fantastic AMD prizes (unveiled soon) to enter the new VR year in style.

Read on for more details and to learn how to register.

[u]Registration opens this Saturday[/u]

A maximum of 12 community players can register on a first come, first served basis. Registration will open from [b]Saturday, 23 December 2017 @ 10PM CET / 1PM PT[/b].

Once the 12 slots have been filled, you will be added to a waiting list should any cancellations take place.

Registration, match-making and tournament documentation will be hosted on Challonge.com. Make sure you have a Challonge account ready for when registration opens. Sign up to the Skyworld [url=http://eepurl.com/bf2Yj9]newsletter[/url] to get notified when it does.

[u]Take on the devs![/u]

A certain gauntlet was thrown to the devs, and it did not go unnoticed! Four of us will be participating in this tournament for glory (not prizes). To give you a fair chance at winning *wink* we’re making sure there’s no chance for two devs to be matched up in the finals or semi-finals. 

Prizes won by devs will automatically be diverted to the next-best community player.

[u]Tournament dates[/u]

The tournament is scheduled to kick off on Saturday, 30 December with the finals taking place on Saturday, 13 January. 

When signing up, please take note of the match dates announced below. These are fixed dates: No-shows automatically forfeit a match.

[b]Elimination round 1[/b]: 	Saturday, 30 December 2017 @ 10PM CET / 1PM PT
[b]Elimination round 2[/b]:	Saturday, 6 January 2018 @ 10PM CET / 1PM PT
[b]Semi-finals[/b]:		Saturday, 13 January 2018 @ 8PM CET / 11AM PT
[b]Finals[/b]:			Saturday, 13 January 2018 @ 10PM CET / 1PM PT

[h1]Game Guide[/h1]

Whether it’s to prepare for the Holiday 2017 Tournament or just to improve your solo or multiplayer game, read up on everything Skyworld and hone your skills with the [b]Skyworld Game Guide by Vertigo Games[/b]. It explains all about Skyworld’s gameplay, menus and control schemes, offers tips and tricks to perfect your play style, and includes character statistics. 

Visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/manageguide/?id=1181192962]Skyworld Game Guide[/url].

notes.title: Patch 3 Now Live
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8212938/58e23389cf4ae50d8948837fbc3abb2b958b6662.png[/img]

Hi all,

Another update from our side. The 3rd patch for Skyworld is live, full patch notes are below. Among other things, this fulfills a recurring request from players: the option to switch on/off the table flip. By switching it off, you will instead of the table flip see a black fade. 

[h1]Added features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Option to split language settings for audio and text.
    [*]Option to switch on/off table flip.
[/list]

[h1]Balance tweaks:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Reworked towers and region rules.
    [*]Towers can now be destroyed even if the enemy general is in the same region.
    [*]Generals now need to stand next to the tower in order to defend them.
    [*]Reworked mission 3 end sequence: 
	- Instead of switching to Insane difficulty during mission 3 to force players to lose (as part of the story line), players are now propelled into the end sequence to avoid player confusion.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug that starts the game in demo mode when you own the full version. (29-11)
    [*]Fixed bug that soft-locks the game when the player loses a game.
    [*]Fixed capture/stream camera.
	- Now properly works in the sublevels and during table flip.
	- Now does not respond to VIVE controller input anymore.
    [*]Fixed localization errors.
	- Fixed menus not adjusting after changing language.
	- Fixed text out of bound in panels.
    [*]Fixed paratrooper ghost incorrectly rotated.
    [*]Fixed voice lines being cut off in the combat arena.
    [*]Added voice effects for Jeffrey and the Overlord.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and let us know your thoughts on this latest version of Skyworld below!

notes.title: Skyworld Patch 1 Now Live
notes.content:
First off, a special thank you for your patience to those who have been waiting for their language to be implemented in the game.

We have now pushed our first update live on Steam and Oculus Home which not only includes a range of gameplay changes, bug fixes and additional features, but most of our planned in-game languages as well. 

Have a look at the patch notes below, give the new update a spin and let us know your thoughts on the discussion boards!

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Getting stuck at the end of mission 3
[*]Getting stuck in the mine section in mission 2
[*]Mission 8 reload issue
[*]Menu book not opening at the start of the game
[*]Tool tips sometimes not showing backgrounds
[*]Getting stuck on "Insane" after mission 3
[*]Re-center world view issue
[*]Occasional freeze upon level end
[*]Losing a worker pawn when holding it while destroying a building
[*]Multiplayer hosting improved
[*]Freeze upon changing graphical presets
[*]Bug showing Berserker in card
[*]Missing audio-files during battle
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]You can now only defend watchtowers while standing next to them with a general (instead of being in the same region)
[*]You can now revive a general even if an enemy general is your home region
Magic Barrier now clears active spells in its area, but these become active again afterwards
[*]Mission 3 now says "You've Escaped" when you complete it successfully
Spells are now cheaper to research (except Freeze)
[*]Upgrade costs for units level 2 (silver) and 3 (gold) are now more expensive
[*]Mission 2, 4, and 6 are now a little more easy in the beginning
[*]Knight now has a longer cooldown between attacks
[*]Removed "Very Easy", "Very Hard" and "Insane" Campaign settings, tweaked other settings
[*]Removed "Very Easy" and "Insane" Skirmish settings, tweaked other settings
[/list]

[h1]Added features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Streamer Custom Camera feature
[/list] 

[h1]Language update[/h1]
[list]
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Russian
[*] Japanese
[/list] 

We have been promised by our localization agency that Chinese and Korean should follow any moment now. We will implement these as soon as we receive them and expect both to be live early next week. 

感谢您的耐心等待!
양해 해 주셔서 감사합니다!
[i][Translated using Google Translate][/i]

notes.title: Hotfix - "Wait for air support" issue (Ch. 3)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks to your feedback on the forums, we have just pushed live a hotfix which corrects the following issue in Chapter 3:

Players would get stuck after beating the enemy, as the game would wait until the player is defeated. As a result, it kept showing "Wait for air support", blocking players from making any further progress. 

This issue has now been fixed.

notes.title: An announcement on in-game languages
notes.content:
While Skyworld was supposed to launch with a whole range of languages, our localization unfortunately has been slightly delayed due to factors outside of our control. 

Apart from the current English in-game language, we will update the game to include the following languages as soon as possible:

- Chinese
- German
- French
- Italian
- Spanish
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean

Apologies for the small delay and inconvenience this has caused. We will update you here and via the newsletter when the language update hits.
